title: Balayan Bay Field Museum row-level historical evidence decisions
taxonomyMethod: Exact AphiaRecordsByName lookup; accepted status, species rank, self-valid AphiaID and exact valid name required.

qualityIssueInterpretations.handling: Coordinate-derived flag retained; no GBIF coordinate or point is used. The source label's Bay locality remains a textual historical locality only.
Coordinate datum warning retained; coordinates are excluded from the review and no map point is admitted.

GBIF's registry interpretation flags remain visible. The Field Museum-hosted archive independently gives institution FMNH and collection Fishes for this exact catalog number, resolving source-record attribution for this cross-check without deleting the GBIF flags.
GBIF inferred status from individualCount rather than an explicit occurrenceStatus. Treat the dated preserved specimen as historical collection evidence only, not as a current-presence statement.

decision.reason: The institution-hosted archive confirms a dated FMNH preserved specimen with Balayan Bay locality text and CC0 terms; the exact species name is accepted in WoRMS and agrees with GBIF. Preserve year-only precision and all GBIF flags. This is eligible as a historical, text-locality research assertion; it does not justify a coordinate, current-presence, or complete-inventory claim. Balayan Bay is outside the current Cavite app pilot, so no public app row is added in this step.
